about: #1431: the version plans the Knowledge import loads (scripts/knowledge/versions.ts). Hand-kept by agents, and only from what the PM has already ruled: what is in a version is the PM's, so every entry names the rulings it rests on (ruled_by). To change a plan, edit it here and add `changed` with the why and the outcome that changed; the import refuses a changed plan with no why.

versions.why: Launch B, the PM, 2026-11-23: "B." then "Approve launch B". Must-haves only, so the Sacramento area can open to real sign-ups on Wednesday 2027-01-06; what is not needed to open follows in January. The opening is a beta of one market, tested until about April or May 2027, with production after (D-0416).
outcomes: Sacramento opens as a beta on Wednesday 2027-01-06, after a private dry run the week of 2026-12-28
The beta tests the Sacramento-area market until about April or May 2027
versions.appetite: Must-haves only, by Wednesday 2027-01-06: nothing below the cut line holds the opening.

leaves_out.reason: Launch B: stickers, item tags and Google or Apple sign-in are not needed to open and follow in January.
